# NEW 2026-11-22 v12.0 Wave 7 Worker 1 Slot 94: Eurasian Concert, Neutral Buffer Land Ownership & 12 Native IO Voting Resolutions (oe_con_, 0 vanilla/GUI overrides). Generated by gen_v120_concert_resolutions.py; edit the generator, not this file.

# ==============================================================================
# Slot 94 Scheduler Pulse (O(1) short-circuit: January & July only)
# ==============================================================================

# Country scope (called by gen_mainline_lock.py Slot 94).
oe_con_monthly = {
	if = {
		limit = {
			NOT = { oe_con_rule_is_off = yes }
			NOT = { has_global_variable = oe_con_pulse_cd }
			OR = {
				current_month = 1
				current_month = 7
			}
		}
		set_global_variable = { name = oe_con_pulse_cd days = 20 }
		if = {
			limit = { oe_con_can_found_concert = yes }
			oe_con_found_eurasian_concert = yes
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = {
				exists = international_organization:oe_io_eurasian_concert
				current_month = 1
			}
			oe_con_invite_rising_powers = yes
			international_organization:oe_io_eurasian_concert = {
				oe_con_sync_pentarchy_and_buffers = yes
			}
			oe_con_ai_leader_propose_check = yes
		}
	}
}

# ==============================================================================
# Core Concert Founding, Pentarchy Ranking & Utility Effects
# ==============================================================================

# Any scope. Safely increments global passed-resolution audit counter.
oe_con_bump_passed_counter = {
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { has_global_variable = oe_con_resolutions_passed } }
		set_global_variable = { name = oe_con_resolutions_passed value = 0 }
	}
	change_global_variable = { name = oe_con_resolutions_passed add = 1 }
}

# Any scope. Marks the four major Eurasian straits as treaty free-passage ports if Concert-held.
oe_con_mark_free_strait_ports = {
	if = {
		limit = { exists = international_organization:oe_io_eurasian_concert }
		location:hormuz = {
			if = {
				limit = {
					has_owner = yes
					owner ?= { is_member_of_international_organization = international_organization:oe_io_eurasian_concert }
				}
				set_variable = { name = oe_con_free_strait_port years = 15 }
			}
		}
		location:malacca = {
			if = {
				limit = {
					has_owner = yes
					owner ?= { is_member_of_international_organization = international_organization:oe_io_eurasian_concert }
				}
				set_variable = { name = oe_con_free_strait_port years = 15 }
			}
		}
		location:constantinople = {
			if = {
				limit = {
					has_owner = yes
					owner ?= { is_member_of_international_organization = international_organization:oe_io_eurasian_concert }
				}
				set_variable = { name = oe_con_free_strait_port years = 15 }
			}
		}
		location:gibraltar = {
			if = {
				limit = {
					has_owner = yes
					owner ?= { is_member_of_international_organization = international_organization:oe_io_eurasian_concert }
				}
				set_variable = { name = oe_con_free_strait_port years = 15 }
			}
		}
	}
}

# Any scope. Creates oe_io_eurasian_concert, invites top 12 Great Powers + major Eurasian realms, syncs Pentarchy, notifies players.
oe_con_found_eurasian_concert = {
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { exists = international_organization:oe_io_eurasian_concert } }
		ordered_great_power = {
			limit = {
				is_rebel_country = no
				is_subject = no
				country_type = location
				num_locations > 0
			}
			order_by = great_power_score
			max = 1
			check_range_bounds = no
			save_scope_as = oe_con_founder
		}
		if = {
			limit = { exists = scope:oe_con_founder }
			create_international_organization = {
				type = international_organization_type:oe_io_eurasian_concert

				limit = {
					is_rebel_country = no
					is_subject = no

				}

				save_scope_as = oe_con_invitee

# Any scope. Annual refresh: admits rising top-12 Great Powers into an existing Concert.
oe_con_invite_rising_powers = {
	if = {
		limit = { exists = international_organization:oe_io_eurasian_concert }
		ordered_great_power = {
			limit = {
				oe_con_is_eligible_concert_member = yes
				NOT = { is_member_of_international_organization = international_organization:oe_io_eurasian_concert }
			}
			order_by = great_power_score
			max = 12
			check_range_bounds = no
			save_scope_as = oe_con_rising_gp
			international_organization:oe_io_eurasian_concert = {
				add_country_to_international_organization = scope:oe_con_rising_gp
			}
		}
	}
}

# International organization scope (oe_io_eurasian_concert). Deterministically ranks top 5 Pentarchy Seats & updates Buffer States.
oe_con_sync_pentarchy_and_buffers = {
	save_scope_as = oe_con_io_sync
	# Clear old Pentarchy Seats before re-ranking top 5 by great_power_score so max_countries = 5 never blocks reshuffling.
	every_international_organization_member = {
		save_scope_as = oe_con_sync_m
		scope:oe_con_io_sync = {
			if = {
				limit = {
					country_has_special_status = {
						type = special_status:oe_con_pentarchy_seat
						country = scope:oe_con_sync_m
					}
				}
				international_organization_remove_special_status = {
					type = special_status:oe_con_pentarchy_seat
					country = scope:oe_con_sync_m
				}
			}
		}
	}
	ordered_international_organization_member = {
		limit = {
			is_rebel_country = no
			is_subject = no
			num_locations > 0
		}
		order_by = great_power_score
		max = 5
		check_range_bounds = no
		save_scope_as = oe_con_pent_m
		scope:oe_con_io_sync = {
			international_organization_add_special_status = {
				type = special_status:oe_con_pentarchy_seat
				country = scope:oe_con_pent_m
			}
		}
	}
	# Keep neutral buffer status synchronized for members whose capital is inside the neutral buffer jurisdiction.
	every_international_organization_member = {
		if = {
			limit = {
				is_rebel_country = no
				is_subject = no
				is_hegemon = no
				num_locations > 0
				num_locations <= 25
				capital ?= { is_owned_by_international_organization = scope:oe_con_io_sync }
			}
			save_scope_as = oe_con_buf_sync_m
			scope:oe_con_io_sync = {
				if = {
					limit = {
						NOT = {
							country_has_special_status = {
								type = special_status:oe_con_neutral_buffer_member
								country = scope:oe_con_buf_sync_m
							}
						}
					}
					international_organization_add_special_status = {
						type = special_status:oe_con_neutral_buffer_member
						country = scope:oe_con_buf_sync_m
					}
				}
			}
		}
	}
}

# Any scope. Annual AI Concert leader proposal check (strictly silent unless 0 active votes exist).
oe_con_ai_leader_propose_check = {
	if = {
		limit = {
			exists = international_organization:oe_io_eurasian_concert
			international_organization:oe_io_eurasian_concert = {
				NOT = { any_active_resolution = { always = yes } }
				leader_country ?= {
					is_ai = yes
					is_rebel_country = no
					gold >= 100
					prestige >= 10
				}
			}
		}
		international_organization:oe_io_eurasian_concert = {
			leader_country ?= { save_scope_as = oe_con_ai_prop }
			if = {
				limit = {
					NOT = { has_variable = oe_con_res_anti_hegemon_containment_cd }
					any_great_power = {
						oe_con_is_hegemon_containment_target = yes
						NOT = { this = scope:oe_con_ai_prop }
					}
				}
				ordered_great_power = {
					limit = {
						oe_con_is_hegemon_containment_target = yes
						NOT = { this = scope:oe_con_ai_prop }
					}
					order_by = great_power_score
					max = 1
					check_range_bounds = no
					save_scope_as = oe_con_ai_heg_target
				}
				if = {
					limit = { exists = scope:oe_con_ai_heg_target }
					propose_resolution = {
						resolution = resolution:oe_con_res_anti_hegemon_containment
						actor = scope:oe_con_ai_prop
						recipient = international_organization:oe_io_eurasian_concert
						target = scope:oe_con_ai_heg_target
						vote = yes
					}
				}
			}
			else_if = {
				limit = {
					NOT = { has_variable = oe_con_res_international_sanitary_accord_cd }
					any_international_organization_member = {
						is_rebel_country = no
						oe_dis_country_infected_any = yes
					}
				}
				propose_resolution = {
					resolution = resolution:oe_con_res_international_sanitary_accord
					actor = scope:oe_con_ai_prop
					recipient = international_organization:oe_io_eurasian_concert
					vote = yes
				}
			}
			else_if = {
				limit = {
					NOT = { has_variable = oe_con_res_vienna_constantinople_congress_cd }
					OR = {
						has_global_variable = oe_end_ended
						any_international_organization_member = {
							is_rebel_country = no
							war_exhaustion >= 4
						}
					}
				}
				propose_resolution = {
					resolution = resolution:oe_con_res_vienna_constantinople_congress
					actor = scope:oe_con_ai_prop
					recipient = international_organization:oe_io_eurasian_concert
					vote = yes
				}
			}
			else_if = {
				limit = {
					current_year >= 1650
					NOT = { has_variable = oe_con_res_mare_liberum_clausum_cd }
					scope:oe_con_ai_prop = { num_of_ports > 0 }
				}
				propose_resolution = {
					resolution = resolution:oe_con_res_mare_liberum_clausum
					actor = scope:oe_con_ai_prop
					recipient = international_organization:oe_io_eurasian_concert
					vote = yes
				}
			}
		}
	}
}

# ==============================================================================
# Dev Panel Page 87 Helper Effects (ZERO debug_log; called by DEV_LINES)
# ==============================================================================

# Country scope. Ensures Eurasian Concert exists, admits root, syncs Pentarchy, and fires oe_con.1.
oe_con_dev_found_concert = {
	save_scope_as = oe_con_dev_actor
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { exists = international_organization:oe_io_eurasian_concert } }
		oe_con_found_eurasian_concert = yes
	}
	if = {
		limit = { exists = international_organization:oe_io_eurasian_concert }
		if = {
			limit = { NOT = { is_member_of_international_organization = international_organization:oe_io_eurasian_concert } }
			international_organization:oe_io_eurasian_concert = {
				add_country_to_international_organization = scope:oe_con_dev_actor
			}
		}
		international_organization:oe_io_eurasian_concert = {
			oe_con_sync_pentarchy_and_buffers = yes
		}
		trigger_event_non_silently = oe_con.1
	}
}

# Country scope. Clears all 12 resolution cooldowns across Roman World, Middle Kingdom, and Eurasian Concert.
oe_con_dev_clear_cooldowns = {
	if = {
		limit = { exists = international_organization:oe_byz_roman_world }
		international_organization:oe_byz_roman_world = {
			if = { limit = { has_variable = oe_con_res_pax_romana_arbitration_cd } remove_variable = oe_con_res_pax_romana_arbitration_cd }
			if = { limit = { has_variable = oe_con_res_imperial_joint_embargo_cd } remove_variable = oe_con_res_imperial_joint_embargo_cd }
			if = { limit = { has_variable = oe_con_res_ecumenical_defense_levy_cd } remove_variable = oe_con_res_ecumenical_defense_levy_cd }
			if = { limit = { has_variable = oe_con_res_roman_frontier_jurisdiction_cd } remove_variable = oe_con_res_roman_frontier_jurisdiction_cd }
		}
	}
	if = {
		limit = { exists = international_organization:middle_kingdom }
		international_organization:middle_kingdom = {
			if = { limit = { has_variable = oe_con_res_kanhe_tribute_reassessment_cd } remove_variable = oe_con_res_kanhe_tribute_reassessment_cd }
			if = { limit = { has_variable = oe_con_res_haijin_kaihai_edict_cd } remove_variable = oe_con_res_haijin_kaihai_edict_cd }
			if = { limit = { has_variable = oe_con_res_imperial_frontier_expedition_cd } remove_variable = oe_con_res_imperial_frontier_expedition_cd }
			if = { limit = { has_variable = oe_con_res_grand_duhu_charter_vote_cd } remove_variable = oe_con_res_grand_duhu_charter_vote_cd }
		}
	}
	if = {
		limit = { exists = international_organization:oe_io_eurasian_concert }
		international_organization:oe_io_eurasian_concert = {
			if = { limit = { has_variable = oe_con_res_vienna_constantinople_congress_cd } remove_variable = oe_con_res_vienna_constantinople_congress_cd }
			if = { limit = { has_variable = oe_con_res_anti_hegemon_containment_cd } remove_variable = oe_con_res_anti_hegemon_containment_cd }
			if = { limit = { has_variable = oe_con_res_mare_liberum_clausum_cd } remove_variable = oe_con_res_mare_liberum_clausum_cd }
			if = { limit = { has_variable = oe_con_res_international_sanitary_accord_cd } remove_variable = oe_con_res_international_sanitary_accord_cd }
		}
	}
}

# Country scope. Prepares and proposes a live Roman World resolution (Pax Romana Truce Arbitration).
oe_con_dev_prop_roman = {
	save_scope_as = oe_con_dev_actor
	oe_con_dev_clear_cooldowns = yes
	if = {
		limit = { exists = international_organization:oe_byz_roman_world }
		if = {
			limit = { NOT = { is_member_of_international_organization = international_organization:oe_byz_roman_world } }
			international_organization:oe_byz_roman_world = {
				add_country_to_international_organization = scope:oe_con_dev_actor
			}
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				international_organization:oe_byz_roman_world = {
					NOT = { resolution_is_active = resolution:oe_con_res_pax_romana_arbitration }
				}
			}
			propose_resolution = {
				resolution = resolution:oe_con_res_pax_romana_arbitration
				actor = scope:oe_con_dev_actor
				recipient = international_organization:oe_byz_roman_world
				vote = yes
			}
		}
	}
}

# Country scope. Clears Middle Kingdom resolution cooldowns and proposes Kanhe Tribute Reassessment if leader/governor.
oe_con_dev_prop_celestial = {
	save_scope_as = oe_con_dev_actor
	oe_con_dev_clear_cooldowns = yes
	if = {
		limit = { exists = international_organization:middle_kingdom }
		if = {
			limit = {
				OR = {
					is_leader_of_international_organization = international_organization:middle_kingdom
					has_special_status_in_international_organization = {
						type = special_status:celestial_governor
						international_organization = international_organization:middle_kingdom
					}
				}
				international_organization:middle_kingdom = {
					NOT = { resolution_is_active = resolution:oe_con_res_kanhe_tribute_reassessment }
				}
			}
			propose_resolution = {
				resolution = resolution:oe_con_res_kanhe_tribute_reassessment
				actor = scope:oe_con_dev_actor
				recipient = international_organization:middle_kingdom
				vote = yes
			}
		}
	}
}

# Country scope. Internal helper: ensures Concert exists and root is member before proposing Concert votes.
oe_con_dev_ensure_concert_member = {
	save_scope_as = oe_con_dev_actor
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { exists = international_organization:oe_io_eurasian_concert } }
		oe_con_found_eurasian_concert = yes
	}
	if = {
		limit = { exists = international_organization:oe_io_eurasian_concert }
		if = {
			limit = { NOT = { is_member_of_international_organization = international_organization:oe_io_eurasian_concert } }
			international_organization:oe_io_eurasian_concert = {
				add_country_to_international_organization = scope:oe_con_dev_actor
			}
		}
	}
}

# Country scope. Proposes Congress of Vienna & Constantinople.
oe_con_dev_prop_vienna = {
	oe_con_dev_ensure_concert_member = yes
	oe_con_dev_clear_cooldowns = yes
	save_scope_as = oe_con_dev_actor
	if = {
		limit = { exists = international_organization:oe_io_eurasian_concert }
		if = {
			limit = {
				NOT = { is_leader_of_international_organization = international_organization:oe_io_eurasian_concert }
				NOT = {
					has_special_status_in_international_organization = {
						type = special_status:oe_con_pentarchy_seat
						international_organization = international_organization:oe_io_eurasian_concert
					}
				}
			}
			international_organization:oe_io_eurasian_concert = {
				set_leader_country = scope:oe_con_dev_actor
			}
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				international_organization:oe_io_eurasian_concert = {
					NOT = { resolution_is_active = resolution:oe_con_res_vienna_constantinople_congress }
				}
			}
			propose_resolution = {
				resolution = resolution:oe_con_res_vienna_constantinople_congress
				actor = scope:oe_con_dev_actor
				recipient = international_organization:oe_io_eurasian_concert
				vote = yes
			}
		}
	}
}

# Country scope. Proposes Global Straits Convention (Mare Liberum vs Mare Clausum).
oe_con_dev_prop_mare = {
	oe_con_dev_ensure_concert_member = yes
	oe_con_dev_clear_cooldowns = yes
	save_scope_as = oe_con_dev_actor
	if = {
		limit = {
			exists = international_organization:oe_io_eurasian_concert
			international_organization:oe_io_eurasian_concert = {
				NOT = { resolution_is_active = resolution:oe_con_res_mare_liberum_clausum }
			}
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				num_of_ports <= 0
				NOT = { is_leader_of_international_organization = international_organization:oe_io_eurasian_concert }
			}
			international_organization:oe_io_eurasian_concert = {
				set_leader_country = scope:oe_con_dev_actor
			}
		}
		propose_resolution = {
			resolution = resolution:oe_con_res_mare_liberum_clausum
			actor = scope:oe_con_dev_actor
			recipient = international_organization:oe_io_eurasian_concert
			vote = yes
		}
	}
}

# Country scope. Proposes International Maritime Sanitary Accord.
oe_con_dev_prop_sanitary = {
	oe_con_dev_ensure_concert_member = yes
	oe_con_dev_clear_cooldowns = yes
	set_global_variable = { name = oe_con_sanitary_unlock value = 1 }
	save_scope_as = oe_con_dev_actor
	if = {
		limit = {
			exists = international_organization:oe_io_eurasian_concert
			international_organization:oe_io_eurasian_concert = {
				NOT = { resolution_is_active = resolution:oe_con_res_international_sanitary_accord }
			}
		}
		propose_resolution = {
			resolution = resolution:oe_con_res_international_sanitary_accord
			actor = scope:oe_con_dev_actor
			recipient = international_organization:oe_io_eurasian_concert
			vote = yes
		}
	}
}

# Country scope. Proposes Anti-Hegemonic Containment Pact against the strongest non-self Great Power.
oe_con_dev_prop_antiheg = {
	oe_con_dev_ensure_concert_member = yes
	oe_con_dev_clear_cooldowns = yes
	save_scope_as = oe_con_dev_actor
	if = {
		limit = {
			exists = international_organization:oe_io_eurasian_concert
			international_organization:oe_io_eurasian_concert = {
				NOT = { resolution_is_active = resolution:oe_con_res_anti_hegemon_containment }
			}
		}
		ordered_great_power = {
			limit = {
				is_rebel_country = no
				num_locations > 0
				NOT = { this = scope:oe_con_dev_actor }
			}
			order_by = great_power_score
			max = 1
			check_range_bounds = no
			save_scope_as = oe_con_dev_heg
			if = {
				limit = { NOT = { oe_con_is_hegemon_containment_target = yes } }
				set_variable = { name = oe_heg2_sim_multi_heg years = 10 }
			}
		}
		if = {
			limit = { exists = scope:oe_con_dev_heg }
			propose_resolution = {
				resolution = resolution:oe_con_res_anti_hegemon_containment
				actor = scope:oe_con_dev_actor
				recipient = international_organization:oe_io_eurasian_concert
				target = scope:oe_con_dev_heg
				vote = yes
			}
		}
	}
}

# Country scope. Adds current capital to Concert Neutral Buffer Land Ownership to inspect stripes & local modifier.
oe_con_dev_buffer_test = {
	oe_con_dev_ensure_concert_member = yes
	save_scope_as = oe_con_dev_actor
	if = {
		limit = {
			exists = international_organization:oe_io_eurasian_concert
			capital ?= {
				is_land = yes
				is_passable = yes
			}
		}
		capital ?= {
			save_scope_as = oe_con_dev_cap
			international_organization:oe_io_eurasian_concert = {
				add_location_to_international_organization = scope:oe_con_dev_cap
			}
		}
	}
}

# Country scope. Dev Rule #18 override helpers (Standard / Off / Clear).
oe_con_dev_rule_override_standard = {
	set_global_variable = { name = oe_v120_rule_override value = 1 }
}

oe_con_dev_rule_override_off = {
	set_global_variable = { name = oe_v120_rule_override value = 3 }
}

oe_con_dev_rule_override_clear = {
	if = {
		limit = { has_global_variable = oe_v120_rule_override }
		remove_global_variable = oe_v120_rule_override
	}
}

# Country scope. Opens live audit readout event oe_con.90.
oe_con_dev_readout = {
	trigger_event_non_silently = oe_con.90
}
